name: research-quic
description: A research question that needs synthesis across standards, measurements and trade-offs, judged on the citation check, the facts a correct answer must contain, enough independent sources and the independent fact-checker.

input.question: Should our company's public web APIs and website move to HTTP/3? Explain QUIC and HTTP/3: which RFCs standardised them and when; how QUIC differs from TCP plus TLS 1.3 (handshake round trips, 0-RTT and its replay risk, connection IDs and migration, head-of-line blocking at the stream level); how widely HTTP/3 is deployed today, with a dated figure from a named measurement source; and when it does not help or causes problems (networks that block or throttle UDP, CPU cost, middlebox visibility). End with a recommendation and what to measure in a pilot.
input.audience: a CTO and the platform team deciding whether to run a pilot
